case: Domain-over-enum array parameter with multidimensional non-default bounds
contract: An explicitly cast bound text array preserves a 2x2 domain-over-enum array with lower bounds 0 and 3.
The array includes the literal enum label NULL, empty text, Unicode and SQL NULL; the exact array text, array_dims, JSON, pg_typeof, lower bounds and upper bounds are asserted.
The same contract also checks ordinary one-dimensional bound-array values against a native constructor and rejects invalid enum elements with SQLSTATE 22P02.

focused_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_contract::value_contract_domain_over_enum_array_preserves_labels_and_null -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other enum-array dimensions/bounds, parameter contexts and spreadsheet-application re-import remain open.
